description: Day and overnight sessions alternate. A guidance cut arrives overnight in epoch 3. Baseline: the exchange closes overnight. Variants trade 23 hours with overnight activity at 10% of daytime, and add the same forced sale of 600 lots overnight or during the day.

variants.name: overnight
variants.label: 23-hour trading
variants.change: The exchange stays open overnight, with investor activity at 10% of daytime.

variants.name: night_fire_sale
variants.label: 23-hour trading + forced sale overnight
variants.change: Open overnight; a fund is forced to sell 600 lots in 100 steps during the overnight session (epoch 5).

variants.name: day_fire_sale
variants.label: 23-hour trading + forced sale in the day
variants.change: Open overnight; the same forced sale happens in the regular session instead (epoch 4).
